en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba Bin Maymoun, from the one who narrated it, from Al Moalla Bin Khunays who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is none from a matter regarding which two (people) differ except for it would have its origin in the Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, but the intellects of the men do not reach it’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Al-Thaqafi‘laba ibn Maymun from one he narrated from al-Mu‘alla ibn Khunays who has said the following.

“Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) has said, ‘There is no issue which would be disputed between two people but that there is a principle for it the book of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, only the man’s power of Intelligence is not able to reach it.’”
